lane: مُحَصْرَمٌ Butter _dissundered,_ or _separated_ [_into clots_], _by reason of intense cold; not coalescing;_ (K;) [as also ↓مُتَحَصْرِمٌ: see Q. 2.] === A _scanty,_ or _small,_ gift. (TA.) === Anything _straitened,_ or _scanted._ (TA.) === See also حِصْرِمٌ, in two places. ___ شَاعِرٌ مُحَصْرَمٌ _i. q._ مُخَضْرَمٌ, (K,) which is the more common term; meaning _A poet that lived in the time of paganism and in that of El-Islám._ (TA.)

entries.text: (مُحَصْرَمٌ) : قَلِيلُ الْخَيْرِ. وَالْأَصْلُ أَنَّ الْمِيمَ زَائِدَةٌ، وَإِنَّمَا هُوَ مِنَ الْحَصُورِ وَالْحَصِرِ.||وَمِنْ هَذَا الْبَابِ
